settingName.description:
The enum value to be set to `HIDE_WEBEX_APP`.
 * `HIDE_WEBEX_APP` - Webex will continue to run but its windows will be closed by default. Users can still access Webex from the system tray on Windows or the Menu Bar on Mac.

value.description: The boolean value to update the `HIDE_WEBEX_APP` setting, either `true` or `false`. Set to `null` to delete the `HIDE_WEBEX_APP` setting.
